items.headline: Pruneyard asks to push back office tower deadlines to 2031
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on the Pruneyard Center Association's request to extend the phasing deadlines for Phases 3 and 4 to December 31, 2031. Those phases include a five-story office building, parking structure expansions and additional commercial buildings at S. Bascom Ave and E. Campbell Ave. The request also covers extending the tentative parcel map, which would create a fourth parcel for the office building. The Planning Commission recommended that the council approve it.

items.headline: 692,634-square-foot Walsh Avenue office project review pushed to November 18
items.summary: The October 14 Development Review Hearing agenda listed a continuance of the architectural review (PLN25-00536) for a three-story, 692,634-square-foot office building at 2300 and 2350 Walsh Avenue to the November 18, 2026, hearing. The plan calls for demolishing the existing structures, building 2,050 below-grade parking stalls, and adding a pedestrian bridge over Walsh Avenue.

items.headline: Two small homes proposed to replace one house at 575 Franklin Street
items.summary: The October 14 Development Review Hearing agenda listed an architectural review (PLN25-00567) to demolish a single-family house and detached garage at 575 Franklin Street. In their place would go a two-story, 1,462-square-foot home and a one-story, 778-square-foot home. The site is within 200 feet of a historic resource inventory property.
